title: Bonolota Express
label: Character convergence
text: Reviewers liked how the separate storylines keep crossing at key moments, so that the whole cast ends up tied together.

title: Marc by Sofia
label: Jacobs' influence recognized
text: Reviewers felt the film makes a persuasive case that Jacobs is underrated, and that few people have shaped modern fashion as much as he has.

title: Forgotten Love
label: Clunky plot exposition
text: Reviewers faulted the script for having characters spell out the plot to one another in stilted, unnatural exchanges.
